note: Styles are choices INSIDE the Shikshaq brand, in the AQ engine's sense: a judged recipe, drawn educated-random. A style never overrides a hard rule (accent is semantic per pillar, contrast is measured, bone ground family only, radii from the site scale, real assets only). `kit` is a preset name resolved in src/style.mjs.

styles.mechanism: Warm bone page, saturated slabs punctuate it, one dark CTA bar anchors the bottom.
styles.recipe: The house default. Ground bone, slab radius 32, CTA as a near-black bar with an accent arrow, classic mascot kit.

styles.mechanism: The whole page is tinted with the pillar's accent, so a feed grid reads as colour-coded rooms.
styles.recipe: Ground is the accent's tint (peach for teachers, lavender for papers, mint for tips). Bone cards keep their ring so they still separate.

styles.mechanism: A quieter, more editorial page: darker warm ground, ring CTA instead of a black bar.
styles.recipe: Ground muted warm, CTA a bone bar with a hairline ring, slab radius 30, quiet mascot kit (calm faces, no burst).

styles.mechanism: The CTA itself becomes the second saturated object, so the action is the loudest thing after the hero.
styles.recipe: CTA bar filled with the accent, ink or white type chosen by measured contrast, black arrow dot. Sticker tilts the other way.

styles.mechanism: Slightly tighter corners and quiet faces: friendlier to a parent audience than the bold kit.
styles.recipe: Slab radius 28 (site scale), quiet kit, otherwise the default.

styles.mechanism: Cheering and winking characters tilted harder, for student-facing posts.
styles.recipe: Lively kit (flower and burst bodies, cheer and wink faces, bigger tilts), sticker tilts left.

styles.mechanism: The tall headline column moves to the left, so the eye reads headline first and the bento second.
styles.recipe: Mirror the three columns, random mascot kit.

styles.mechanism: Subjects are shuffled so the same eight tiles do not sit in the same order every week.
styles.recipe: Seeded shuffle of the eight subject tiles, mixed mascot kit.

styles.mechanism: No black bar at all: the page stays light, saturation comes only from the slab and the characters.
styles.recipe: CTA as a bone ring bar, slab radius 30, random kit.

styles.mechanism: Maximum energy inside the brand: tinted room, accent CTA, lively characters.
styles.recipe: Use sparingly, at most one week in six. Accent tint ground, accent CTA bar, lively kit.
